purpose: Operator-tunable competition scoring order and bounded recovery
notes: Successful pick_place earns both stages when the part is grasped and released. A failed action never retries blindly; inspect the gripper/part and choose retry, skip, or stop. Reorder this list only after physical evidence. Menu option 7 reloads this file while the menu is running.
pick_only_note: Pick-only actions retain the part and cannot be chained across parts. Use them for individual validation; the scoring plan uses pick_place so the hand is freed for the next part.
